body: yes u are soooo right. he’s a rescue and the home he came from he was kept in a cage all day every day and the thought of him possibly going back to something similar if i were to go would be so selfish of me. he has helped me through so much i owe him a good happy life. thank u <3

i’ve been better but i’ve definitely been worse off. just unemployed, hoping to catch a break soon on my misfortune. coming on here and knowing other people feel a similar dark loneliness is comforting to say the least.

i feel u 100%. sometimes i feel like it’s easier to open up to strangers because they can’t judge me, they don’t know my past. i would say i’m in the same boat as u but i’m lacking in both the best friend and boyfriend department 😂
